name: Shobi
overview: Shobi is a male biblical figure identified as the son of Nahash from Rabbah, as recorded in 2 Samuel 17:27. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him. His mention is concise, focusing mainly on his lineage and origin.
namesAndTitles: The name Shobi is a proper name that possibly means 'captive' or 'YHWH returns,' according to the Hebrew meaning given in 2 Samuel 17:27. This name is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shobi as the son of Nahash, according to 2 Samuel 17:27. No other family relationships are documented beyond this father-son connection.
scriptureSignificance: Shobi's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his identity as the son of Nahash from Rabbah. His mention in 2 Samuel 17:27 situates him within the historical and political context of the time, highlighting his role as a supporter or ally during David's reign. While details are limited, his inclusion indicates his participation in the broader story of Israel's monarchy and its interactions with neighboring peoples.
